problems.statementHtml: In a long line of people arranged left to right, the \(1013\)th person from the left is also the \(1010\)th person from the right. How many people are in the line?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在一长队人中，从左边数第 \(1013\) 个人同时也是从右边数第 \(1010\) 个人。队伍中共有多少人？

problems.statementHtml: What is \(10! - 7! \cdot 6!?\)
For how many integer values of \(x\) is \(|2x| \le 7\pi?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 对多少个整数 \(x\)，有 \(|2x| \le 7\pi\)？

problems.statementHtml: Balls numbered \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(\ldots\) are deposited in \(5\) bins, labeled \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D,\) and \(E,\) using the following procedure. Ball \(1\) is deposited in bin \(A,\) and balls \(2\) and \(3\) are deposited in bin \(B.\) The next \(3\) balls are deposited in bin \(C,\) the next \(4\) in bin \(D,\) and so on, cycling back to bin \(A\) after balls are deposited in bin \(E.\) (For example, balls numbered \(22,\) \(23,\) \(\ldots,\) \(28\) are deposited in bin \(B\) at step \(7\) of this process.) In which bin is ball \(2024\) deposited?
problems.statementZhHtml: 编号为 \(1\)、\(2\)、\(3\)、\(\ldots\) 的球按下面的过程放入标号为 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\)、\(D\) 和 \(E\) 的 \(5\) 个箱子。球 \(1\) 放入箱子 \(A\)，球 \(2\) 和 \(3\) 放入箱子 \(B\)。接下来的 \(3\) 个球放入箱子 \(C\)，再接下来的 \(4\) 个放入箱子 \(D\)，依此类推；把球放入箱子 \(E\) 之后再循环回到箱子 \(A\)。（例如，在这个过程的第 \(7\) 步，编号为 \(22\)、\(23\)、\(\ldots\)、\(28\) 的球放入箱子 \(B\)。）球 \(2024\) 放入哪个箱子？

problems.statementHtml:
In the following expression, Melanie changed some of the plus signs to minus signs:

\[1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + \cdots + 97 + 99\]

When the new expression was evaluated, it was negative. What is the least number of plus signs that Melanie could have changed to minus signs?
problems.statementZhHtml:
在下面的式子中，Melanie 把一些加号改成了减号：

\[1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + \cdots + 97 + 99\]

新式子计算后的值是负数。她最少要把多少个加号改成减号？

problems.statementHtml: A rectangle has integer side lengths and an area of \(2024.\) What is the least possible perimeter of the rectangle?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个长方形的边长都是整数，面积为 \(2024\)。它的周长最小可能是多少？

problems.statementHtml: What is the remainder when \(7^{2024} + 7^{2025} + 7^{2026}\) is divided by \(19?\)
Let \(N\) be the product of all the positive integer divisors of \(42.\) What is the units digit of \(N?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 令 \(N\) 为 \(42\) 的所有正整数因数的乘积。\(N\) 的个位数字是多少？
实数 \(a\)，\(b\) 和 \(c\) 的算术平均数为 \(0\)。\(a^2\)，\(b^2\) 和 \(c^2\) 的算术平均数为 \(10\)。\(ab\)，\(ac\) 和 \(bc\) 的算术平均数是多少？
problems.statementHtml: Real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) have arithmetic mean \(0.\) The arithmetic mean of \(a^2,\) \(b^2,\) and \(c^2\) is \(10.\) What is the arithmetic mean of \(ab,\) \(ac,\) and \(bc?\)

Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram, and \(E\) is the midpoint of the side \(\overline{AD}.\) Let \(F\) be the intersection of lines \(EB\) and \(AC.\) What is the ratio of the area of quadrilateral \(CDEF\) to the area of triangle \(CFB?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 四边形 \(ABCD\) 是平行四边形，\(E\) 是边 \(\overline{AD}\) 的中点。令 \(F\) 为直线 \(EB\) 和 \(AC\) 的交点。四边形 \(CDEF\) 的面积与三角形 \(CFB\) 的面积之比是多少？

problems.statementHtml: In the figure below \(WXYZ\) is a rectangle with \(WX = 4\) and \(WZ = 8.\) Point \(M\) lies on \(\overline{XY},\) point \(A\) lies on \(\overline{YZ},\) and \(\angle WMA\) is a right angle. The areas of \(\triangle WXM\) and \(\triangle WAZ\) are equal. What is the area of \(\triangle WMA?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 下图中，\(WXYZ\) 是长方形，且 \(WX = 4\)、\(WZ = 8\)。点 \(M\) 在 \(\overline{XY}\) 上，点 \(A\) 在 \(\overline{YZ}\) 上，且 \(\angle WMA\) 是直角。\(\triangle WXM\) 与 \(\triangle WAZ\) 的面积相等。求 \(\triangle WMA\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: A group of \(100\) students from different countries meet at a mathematics competition. Each student speaks the same number of languages, and, for every pair of students \(A\) and \(B,\) student \(A\) speaks some language that student \(B\) does not speak, and student \(B\) speaks some language that student \(A\) does not speak. What is the least possible total number of languages spoken by all the students?
problems.statementZhHtml: 来自不同国家的 \(100\) 名学生在一次数学竞赛中相遇。每名学生会说相同数量的语言，并且对任意两名学生 \(A\) 和 \(B\)，学生 \(A\) 会说某种学生 \(B\) 不会说的语言，同时学生 \(B\) 也会说某种学生 \(A\) 不会说的语言。所有学生会说的语言种类总数最少可能是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Positive integers \(x\) and \(y\) satisfy the equation \(\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y} = \sqrt{1183}.\) What is the minimum possible value of \(x + y?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 正整数 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 满足方程 \(\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y} = \sqrt{1183}\)。\(x + y\) 的最小可能值是多少？

problems.statementHtml: A dartboard is the region \(B\) in the coordinate plane consisting of points \((x, y)\) such that \(|x| + |y| \le 8.\) A target \(T\) is the region where \((x^2 + y^2 - 25)^2 \le 49.\) A dart is thrown and lands at a random point in \(B.\) The probability that the dart lands in \(T\) can be expressed as \(\dfrac{m}{n} \cdot \pi,\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(m + n?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 飞镖盘是坐标平面中的区域 \(B\)，由满足 \(|x| + |y| \le 8\) 的点 \((x, y)\) 组成。目标区域 \(T\) 满足 \((x^2 + y^2 - 25)^2 \le 49\)。一支飞镖随机落在 \(B\) 中。它落在 \(T\) 中的概率可表示为 \(\dfrac{m}{n} \cdot \pi\)，其中 \(m\) 和 \(n\) 是互质的正整数。求 \(m + n\)。

problems.statementHtml: A list of \(9\) real numbers consists of \(1,\) \(2.2,\) \(3.2,\) \(5.2,\) \(6.2,\) \(7,\) as well as \(x,\) \(y,\) \(z\) with \(x \le y \le z.\) The range of the list is \(7,\) and the mean and median are both positive integers. How many ordered triples \((x, y, z)\) are possible?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个由 \(9\) 个实数组成的列表包括 \(1\)、\(2.2\)、\(3.2\)、\(5.2\)、\(6.2\)、\(7\)，以及 \(x\)，\(y\)，\(z\)，其中 \(x \le y \le z\)。这个列表的极差为 \(7\)，平均数和中位数都是正整数。有多少个有序三元组 \((x, y, z)\) 可能？

problems.statementHtml: Jerry likes to play with numbers. One day, he wrote all the integers from \(1\) to \(2024\) on the whiteboard. Then he repeatedly chose four numbers on the whiteboard, erased them, and replaced them by either their sum or their product. (For example, Jerry’s first step might have been to erase \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) and \(5,\) and then write either \(11,\) their sum, or \(30,\) their product, on the whiteboard.) After repeatedly performing this operation, Jerry noticed that all the remaining numbers on the whiteboard were odd. What is the maximum possible number of integers on the whiteboard at that time?
problems.statementZhHtml: Jerry 喜欢玩数字。有一天，他把从 \(1\) 到 \(2024\) 的所有整数都写在白板上。然后他反复选择白板上的四个数，擦掉它们，并用它们的和或积替代。（例如，Jerry 的第一步可能擦掉 \(1\)，\(2\)，\(3\) 和 \(5\)，然后在白板上写下它们的和 \(11\)，或它们的积 \(30\)。）反复进行这个操作后，Jerry 注意到白板上剩下的所有数都是奇数。此时白板上最多可能还剩多少个整数？

problems.statementHtml: In a race among \(5\) snails, there is at most one tie, but that tie can involve any number of snails. For example, the result of the race might be that Dazzler is first; Abby, Cyrus, and Elroy are tied for second; and Bruna is fifth. How many different results of the race are possible?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在 \(5\) 只蜗牛的比赛中，最多只有一次并列，但这次并列可以包含任意数量的蜗牛。例如，比赛结果可能是 Dazzler 第一；Abby、Cyrus 和 Elroy 并列第二；Bruna 第五。共有多少种不同的比赛结果？

problems.statementHtml: How many different remainders can result when the \(100\)th power of an integer is divided by \(125?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个整数的 \(100\) 次方除以 \(125\) 时，可能出现多少种不同的余数？

problems.statementHtml: In the following table, each question mark is to be replaced by “Possible” or “Not Possible” to indicate whether a nonvertical line with the given slope can contain the given number of lattice points (points both of whose coordinates are integers). How many of the \(12\) entries will be “Possible”?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在下表中，每个问号要替换为“可能”或“不可能”，以表示具有给定斜率的非竖直直线是否可能包含给定数量的格点（两个坐标都是整数的点）。这 \(12\) 个位置中有多少个会填“可能”？

problems.statementHtml: Three different pairs of shoes are placed in a row so that no left shoe is next to a right shoe from a different pair. In how many ways can these six shoes be lined up?
problems.statementZhHtml: 三双不同的鞋被排成一行，要求没有一只左脚鞋与来自不同双的右脚鞋相邻。这六只鞋共有多少种排法？

problems.statementHtml: Two straight pipes (circular cylinders), with radii \(1\) and \(\tfrac14,\) lie parallel and in contact on a flat floor. The figure below shows a head-on view. What is the sum of the possible radii of a third parallel pipe lying on the same floor and in contact with both?
problems.statementZhHtml: 两根直管（圆柱体）的半径分别为 \(1\) 和 \(\tfrac14\)，它们平行放置并在平坦地面上相切。下图是正面视图。第三根平行管也放在同一地面上，并且同时与前两根相切。它的可能半径之和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: A group of \(16\) people will be partitioned into \(4\) indistinguishable \(4\)-person committees. Each committee will have one chairperson and one secretary. The number of different ways to make these assignments can be written as \(3^r M,\) where \(r\) and \(M\) are positive integers and \(M\) is not divisible by \(3.\) What is \(r?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: \(16\) 个人将被分成 \(4\) 个不可区分的 \(4\) 人委员会。每个委员会有一名主席和一名秘书。这些安排方式的数量可写成 \(3^r M\)，其中 \(r\) 和 \(M\) 是正整数，且 \(M\) 不被 \(3\) 整除。求 \(r\)。

problems.statementHtml:
The Fibonacci numbers are defined by \(F_1 = 1,\) \(F_2 = 1,\) and \(F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}\) for \(n \ge 3.\) What is

\[\frac{F_2}{F_1} + \frac{F_4}{F_2} + \frac{F_6}{F_3} + \cdots + \frac{F_{20}}{F_{10}}?\]

Let

\[ \begin{aligned} P(m) &= \frac{m}{2} + \frac{m^2}{4} \\ &\quad {}+ \frac{m^4}{8} + \frac{m^8}{8}. \end{aligned} \]

How many of the values of \(P(2022),\) \(P(2023),\) \(P(2024),\) and \(P(2025)\) are integers?
problems.statementZhHtml:
令

\[ \begin{aligned} P(m) &= \frac{m}{2} + \frac{m^2}{4} \\ &\quad {}+ \frac{m^4}{8} + \frac{m^8}{8} \end{aligned}\text{。}\]

\(P(2022)\)、\(P(2023)\)、\(P(2024)\) 和 \(P(2025)\) 中有多少个值是整数？

problems.statementHtml: Each of \(27\) bricks (right rectangular prisms) has dimensions \(a \times b \times c,\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are pairwise relatively prime positive integers. These bricks are arranged to form a \(3 \times 3 \times 3\) block, as shown on the left below. A \(28\)th brick with the same dimensions is introduced, and these bricks are reconfigured into a \(2 \times 2 \times 7\) block, shown on the right. The new block is \(1\) unit taller, \(1\) unit wider, and \(1\) unit deeper than the old one. What is \(a + b + c?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: \(27\) 块砖（长方体）的尺寸都是 \(a \times b \times c\)，其中 \(a\)，\(b\) 和 \(c\) 是两两互质的正整数。这些砖被排成一个 \(3 \times 3 \times 3\) 的长方体块，如下图左侧所示。再加入第 \(28\) 块同样尺寸的砖，并把这些砖重新排成一个 \(2 \times 2 \times 7\) 的长方体块，如右侧所示。新的长方体比旧的高 \(1\) 个单位、宽 \(1\) 个单位、深 \(1\) 个单位。求 \(a + b + c\)。
